defects.title: writer declares dRegion with for="node"
defects.note: appendix Б requires for="graph"; every produced document is invalid

defects.title: reader rejects a document with two state machines
defects.note: cybparser: 'bad data key attribute stateMachine' on the second dStateMachine graph (F-MULTI)
signatures: reject:rejected by libcyberiadaml: bad data key attribute stateMachine

defects.title: reader requires the optional platform meta parameter
defects.note: platform is MAY per §6.9 (CGML-6.9-4-2); every standard document without it is rejected with 'No platform or standardVersion.'
signatures: reject:rejected by cyberiadaml-py: No platform or standardVersion.

defects.title: writer invents default geometry rect 0 0 0 0
defects.note: elements carrying no dGeometry gain one on write; breaks the geometry-mode consistency of §7

defects.title: writer re-emits point geometry as rect with size -1
writer appends a trailing blank line to meta comment bodies
state machine formal name (dFormalName) dropped on write
reader rejects formal comments other than CGML_META and CGML_COMPONENT
defects.note: §6.7 admits arbitrary formal comment names
signatures: reject:rejected by cyberiadaml-js: Неизвестный тип мета-информации traceId/ REQ-42. Ожидается CGML_META или CGML_COMPONENT.

defects.title: reader rejects rect-valued transition label geometry
defects.note: dLabelGeometry admits rect in full geometry mode (§7)
signatures: reject:rejected by cyberiadaml-js: Нет дочернего <point> у <data> с ключом dLabelGeometry

defects.title: writer emits a node with an empty id for a multi-machine document
region graph id replaced by the parent node id
defects.note: duplicates the parent id, violating document-wide id uniqueness (§5.9)

defects.title: writer places dNote after dGeometry on comment nodes
defects.note: dNote must be the first data key of a comment node (§6.6)

defects.title: reader drops nodes without dName, leaving dangling transitions
defects.note: vertices and comments carry no dName and are skipped on read while their edges survive; 15 of 19 outputs are invalid

defects.title: writer renames the meta comment node to 'coreMeta'
meta parameters beyond standardVersion/platform dropped on write
defects.note: the converter serializes only the standard pair; name, eventPropagation and other §6.9 parameters are lost

defects.title: comment link to a transition re-written without dPivot
defects.note: the edge then reads as a plain transition targeting an edge id (§8.5)

defects.title: reader crashes on an additional namespace attribute of graphml
defects.note: the extra xmlns:* attribute reaches a pydantic model as an unexpected keyword argument; §5.1 (CGML-5.1-3) tolerates such attributes

defects.title: reader rejects dCollapsed on a composite state
defects.note: cybparser: 'Trying to set collapsed flag for non-state node c0' (F-EXT-C)
signatures: reject:rejected by libcyberiadaml: Trying to set collapsed flag for non-state node c0

defects.title: reader rejects backslash-escaped brackets in guards
defects.note: §6.8 (CGML-6.8-8) mandates \\[ \\] inside guard expressions
signatures: reject:rejected by libcyberiadaml: edge action text didn't match the regexp

defects.title: reader crashes on an event description without '/'
defects.note: line[..line.IndexOf('/')] with IndexOf returning -1 (CyberiadaGraphMLConverter.cs)
signatures: crash:Unhandled exception. System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException: length ('-1') must be a non-negative value. (Parameter 'length')

defects.title: reader fails on an event description without '/'
defects.note: TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading trim)' surfaced as a rejection
signatures: reject:rejected by cyberiadaml-js: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')

defects.title: reader drops the defer event parameter
defects.note: defer placed after the '/' separator (§6.8.1) is lost on round-trip
signatures: dump:'    action event "TICK" defer:'|'    action event "TICK":'

defects.title: writer alters polyline point coordinates
defects.note: F-GEO-F polyline point 270,30 re-emitted as 270,30.38 in full geometry mode
signatures: dump:'    polyline: point # # point # # point # #'|'    polyline: point # # point # # point # #'

defects.title: writer trims the trailing space of a formal comment name
defects.note: the standard's Г.3 example names its components ' CGML_COMPONENT ' with spaces; the name is verbatim text (§6.6)

defects.title: writer places data keys after the region subgraph of a node
defects.note: appendix А order: the node's data keys precede its region graph elements

defects.title: writer trims the whitespace of a formal comment name
defects.note: ' CGML_COMPONENT ' (standard Г.3) re-emitted as 'CGML_COMPONENT'

defects.title: component comments re-written as same-named states
defects.note: the two CGML_COMPONENT comments of Г.3 lose dNote and collide on their name (CGML-6.2-3)
